evidence.title: Introducing Mellum2: A 12B Mixture-of-Experts Model by JetBrains

summary: JetBrains has released Mellum2, a 12-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) AI model designed for advanced tasks. The model leverages specialized sub-models to improve efficiency and performance in complex workflows.
title: JetBrains Unveils Mellum2, a 12B Parameter Mixture-of-Experts AI Model
